title: Himalaya Nutravedics India IPO Details
intro:
Himalaya Nutravedics IPO is a book build issue of ₹26.50 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 25.00 lakh shares of ₹26.50 crore.

Himalaya Nutravedics IPO opens for subscription on Sep 22, 2026 and closes on Sep 24, 2026. The allotment for the Himalaya Nutravedics IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 25, 2026. Himalaya Nutravedics IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 29, 2026.

Himalaya Nutravedics IPO is set issue price band at ₹100 to ₹106 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,54,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,81,600.

Nirbhay Capital Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Himalaya Nutravedics IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Himalaya Nutravedics IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Himalaya Nutravedics IPO?
faqs.answer: Himalaya Nutravedics IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,54,400 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Himalaya Nutravedics IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Himalaya Nutravedics IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Himalaya Nutravedics IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Himalaya Nutravedics IPO will be done on Friday, September 25, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 28, 2026 . Check the Himalaya Nutravedics IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Himalaya Nutravedics IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Himalaya Nutravedics IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 29, 2026 .
